description: Run a single-elimination bracket of 2 to 8 domain names and return the seeded field, every match and one champion. Use compare_domains instead when you need estimated values or want to know which orderings are not separable; this result is ordinal, tiers and winners only. Value decides each match with fixed tie-breaks, so the same field always crowns the same champion. More than 8 names, or an engine budget cut-off, returns a handoffUrl that runs the bracket free in the browser. Without a key, uncatalogued names return a report link and nearest published names instead of a result; a fresh engine run needs the HTTP header Authorization: Bearer ad_live_... on the MCP connection and spends one API credit per name run.

domains.description: Names to enter, such as example.com. 2 to 8 run here; 9 to 16 return handoffUrl only.

name: run_bracket

champion.description: Null only when the field was handed off without running here.

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

handoffUrl.description: Present when this request could not run every name here (over the tool cap, or cut off by the per-request engine budget): a link to the free page that runs the same deterministic computation for all of them in the reader's browser. Give it to the user rather than retrying.

next.description: The one step that moves this name forward: {tool, arguments} to call next on this server, or {url} to open; why says what it gets. Null when nothing here does (for a free name, registering it at a registrar).

notAppraised.description: Names that did not run here (over the tool cap, or cut off by the request budget). They never entered the bracket - they were not eliminated. See handoffUrl.

rounds.description: Rounds in order. Each match names both sides, the winner, and why it advanced (value, factors, tiebreak, or bye).

seeded.description: Entrants in seed order, highest appraised value first.

title: Run a domain-name bracket
